1. Game Concepts

100. General

100.1. These sample rules apply to any game of Sample Magic.

100.1a A two-player game is a game that begins with two players.

100.2. To play, each player needs a deck.
Example: A player brings a deck of sixty cards.

7. Additional Rules

702. Keyword Abilities

702.19. Stomping

702.19a Stomping is a static ability that changes how an attacking creature assigns combat damage.

702.19b An attacking creature with stomping assigns excess damage to the player or planeswalker it is attacking.
Example: A 6/6 with stomping blocked by a 2/2 assigns 4 damage to the defending player.

702.19c Stomping over planeswalkers is a variant of stomping.

Glossary

Stomping
A keyword ability that lets excess combat damage carry over. See rule 702.19.

Two-Player Game
A game that begins with only two players. See rule 100.1a.
